capabilities.definition: Answer is one contiguous span directly stated in evidence
capabilities.example: What year was the paper published? → 2024

capabilities.definition: Answer is a named entity (person, org, location, technology)
capabilities.example: What tool is required? → Tundra torque wrench

capabilities.definition: Answer is a number, percentage, measurement, or currency
Answer is a date, year, or time range
Answer is directly contained in a single table cell
capabilities.example: What is the accuracy of Config D? → 91.3

capabilities.definition: Answer requires interpreting one table row
capabilities.example: Which method has highest accuracy? → Config G

capabilities.definition: Answer requires comparing values across table rows
capabilities.example: Which is faster, A or B? → A
What is the third step? → Configure the database
What follows draining the loop? → Remove the filter

capabilities.definition: Relevant evidence spans multiple retrieved chunks
capabilities.example: Trace the programme from start to finish → 1984

capabilities.definition: Answer requires connecting multiple pieces of evidence
capabilities.example: What replaced the booster that was introduced in 1971? → Falcon

capabilities.definition: Answer requires comparing two or more values
capabilities.example: Which method is more accurate? → Neural Network

capabilities.definition: Answer is a definition or explanation
capabilities.example: What is abstention? → withholds an answer
What is in the Epsilon section? → Vermilion coating

capabilities.definition: Evidence does not support an answer
capabilities.example: What is the population of Tokyo? → (no answer)

product_requirements.current_evidence: Extractive QA inherently provides span positions

OPTION_A.name: Improve DistilBERT extractive QA
OPTION_A.description: Fine-tune with targeted table/list data on GPU

OPTION_B.name: Stronger extractive model (DeBERTa-v3-base)
OPTION_B.description: Replace DistilBERT with DeBERTa for better span extraction

OPTION_C.name: Extractive + lightweight synthesis layer
OPTION_C.description: Extractive QA for simple questions, rule-based synthesis for complex
limitations: Synthesis layer is rule-based, not learned
OPTION_C.evidence_requirements: Define synthesis rules for each capability

OPTION_D.name: Generative grounded QA
OPTION_D.description: Small generative model (T5-small) with evidence grounding

OPTION_E.name: Hybrid: extractive + grounded synthesis
OPTION_E.description: Route simple questions to extractive, complex to grounded synthesis
OPTION_E.latency_impact: VARIABLE (extractive for simple, generative for complex)
OPTION_E.provenance_impact: GOOD (extractive path is traceable, generative needs verification)
